name: Spider
intro: A spider is a small animal with eight legs. Most spiders are harmless to people.

sections.title: What does it look like?
sentences: A spider has 8 legs.
Its body has 2 main parts.
Most spiders have 8 eyes.
Spiders are not insects, because insects have 6 legs.
Spiders make silk inside their bodies.

sections.title: Where does it live?
sentences: Spiders live almost everywhere.
They live in deserts, rainforests, and backyards.
Some spiders live in holes lined with silk.
A few spiders even live under water.

sections.title: What does it eat?
sentences: Spiders eat insects.
Some spiders catch bugs in sticky webs.
Other spiders jump on their food.
Spiders help us by eating lots of bugs.

sections.title: How does it grow?
sentences: A mother spider lays eggs.
She wraps them in a silk egg sac.
Baby spiders are called spiderlings.
Spiderlings look like tiny grown-up spiders.
Spiders shed their skin to grow bigger.

sections.title: Fun facts
sentences: Most spiders are harmless to people.
Spiders usually bite only if they feel scared.
Some spiders are smaller than a gummy bear.
A spider can grow back a lost leg.
Some baby spiders ride the wind on silk.

vocab.meaning: An animal with 8 legs, like a spider.
